prompt: A wide, forward-tilting illustration shows an ascending staircase of three glowing machines rising from left to right against a dark sky: on the lowest step, a small, single-purpose robot absorbed in one narrow task; on the middle step, a humanoid machine standing level with a human figure beside it, labeled "AGI"; and on the top step, a radiant, incomprehensibly complex entity of light and circuitry towering far above the human, radiating outward in every direction — symbols of an atom, a chessboard, a speech scroll, and a lightbulb orbiting its halo to show mastery of science, strategy, persuasion, and invention all at once. Below the staircase, at ground level, several rival corporate logos and national flags race side by side along a track heading straight toward the staircase's base, each ignoring warning signs and a broken fence marked "safety checks," while a small group of worried researchers stands at the side holding question-mark-shaped tools, unable to verify or halt the runners — the whole scene hovering in a dreamlike haze to underline that the topmost figure remains hypothetical.
